title: Finite scalar adjunction mates on strict constant integral towers
statement: Use the constant integral scalar adjunction and coefficient datum [def-pur-constant-scalar-tower-adjunction]. For a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E\subset F$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ and their actual integer inclusion $A=\mathcal O_E\to B=\mathcal O_F$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], use the ordinary derived categories of strict constant integral module towers and their normalized proper inverse/direct image adjunctions [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations], and exact open extension [def-cbc-strict-tower-open-extension]. Let $T_W$ be localization of termwise sheafified tensor by the constant ring map and $U_W$ exact restriction of scalars [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Fix $T_W\dashv U_W$ by the ordinary tensor unit $x\mapsto1\otimes x$. Define the compatible constant coefficient datum [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data] by the canonical constant inverse-image isomorphisms. For $g:Z\to W$, let $\delta_g:Rp_{B}U_W\cong U_ZRp_A$ be the identity-on-sections ordinary restriction square derived with its canonical composite units. Define $a_g:Rp_AT_W\to T_ZRp_B$ as the scalar mate of $\delta_g^{-1}$. For an open $j:Z\to W$, let $\gamma_j:U_Zj_{!,A}\cong j_{!,B}U_W$ be the exact descent of the open-unit normalized ordinary restriction comparison and let $b_j:j_{!,A}T_W\to T_Zj_{!,B}$ be its scalar mate. For a compactification $c=(j,p)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], define $I_A^c=j_{!,A}Rp_A$ and the natural transformation $I_A^cT_W\to T_ZI_B^c$ to be $a_p$ after $j_{!,A}$, followed by $Rp_B(b_j)$, in that order.

proof.text: Specialize proEtaleRingRestrictionDirectImage_existsUnique to the constant integer-ring coefficient map and the canonical inverse-image identifications. The coefficient square is change.square. Apply its isomorphism at each object of a strict tower; its naturality gives compatibility with tower transitions and tower morphisms. The section identity holds at each level. Conversely, the HEq section condition determines all section maps, and extensionality for module sheaves, towers, natural transformations and isomorphisms proves uniqueness. This proves properRestrictionOrdinary_existsUnique.

Use tensor_exact and the pointwise ordinary tensor/restriction adjunction. The right adjoint of an exact additive functor preserves K-injective complexes (Adjunction.preservesKInjectiveComplexes). Consequently the right-derived direct-image unit is invertible on the restriction of a K-injective tower complex. Apply the proved square_exists helper of ExactDerivedSquare to the chosen ordinary comparison, and square_unique to any other comparison with the same whole-cochain unit normalization. Their rightDerivedFunctorUnitQ is exactly derivedUnit, so their equations are unitCompatible without changing the normalization. This proves properRestriction_existsUnique. The remaining definitions keep the specified adjunction mates and their ordered proper/open composite. Perform the conversion from the existing helpers to unitCompatible in a proved private generic lemma before specializing to the tower categories, avoiding expensive definitional conversion through the concrete coefficient sheaves.
